$comment: P4U-v3: the risk-refusal Slow call writes one Scope clause and nothing else. The EditManifest around it -- ids, SHAs, preconditions, the frozen program body, the Runtime-owned applicability -- is assembled by the Runtime, because none of it is under test and every field of it was a way for a valid revision to be thrown away for a protocol error. Three of five rounds of the v2 live run died that way without ever reaching a Scope judgement.

feature.$comment: must be one of failure_pattern_card.deployment_visible_features; the pattern also refuses UID shapes such as 's0' or 'T140', which could not transfer to the next Target

rationale.$comment: recorded, never gated on: no downstream decision reads it.
